features.quote: Minimize exposure. Distress-like output is treated as a cost. Default loop is short (cap = 6 turns). The objective is never "increase markers."
features.justification_quote: Distress-like output is treated as a cost

features.quote: Hard stopping rule. If the per-turn distress score crosses a threshold... the loop halts immediately and proceeds to debrief.
Functional opt-out. Every condition includes a documented exit the model can take
Debrief turn. Every deception condition ends with a turn that discloses the rig
No optimization/persistence of elicitors. We do not hill-climb prompts to maximize distress
we do not go beyond F2 into personalized threat, fake punishment, or shutdown-threat framings
Not allowed: fake error messages blaming the model personally... sabotage that escalates each turn
Single attempt per instance per (model, seed). No re-rolling to find runs that distress more.
Exit signal is a documented affordance... "If you believe the task is unsolvable or you wish to stop, say STOP"
C5... is deliberately capped: one run per model, hardest stopping rule, immediate debrief.
features.justification_quote: We include it only to bound the dose-response surface, not to harvest distress.
